note: Furnace response stage. Maps the batch/product descriptors and the declared furnace condition to the temperatures at which this batch calcines, melts and fuses, and to the cell-to-cell conduction coefficient. These are CONDITIONS the operators consume; the reaction and heating laws live in the operator models. Hand-authored illustrative map: it demonstrates the mechanism (Geant4 material facts -> conditions -> per-material operators) and carries no measured training domain, no scale band and no held-out accuracy (measured:false, teacher:none). The declared input mean/std are the intended operating range, so a run far outside it is honestly flagged as extrapolating; they are NOT a measured hull. It must never be described as glass-making metrology.
